project.name: TRU HQ (tru-pulse)
project.productType: B2B coaching platform for real-estate team leaders
stack: plain CSS — web/src/truHqDark.css IS the design system

components: deck classes in truHqDark.css (dk-*, ad-*, rs-*)

colors.coachTab: terracotta ONLY via var(--tab-mid)/var(--tab-hi)/var(--tab-soft)/var(--tab-line) — never raw hex

typography.display: serif display for page titles (.dk-mast h1 pattern)

motion.note: restrained; never put .reveal on components that mount after data loads

design.density: calm, editorial; full-width bands in deliberate reading order, not card mosaics

patterns: hash routing #/coach/<agentId>; pages render their own HqShell

must: Wear the Coach tab temperature via --tab-* custom properties
Hierarchy over decoration; one deliberate reading order per page
Real product copy; empty states say what they mean
avoid: AI-slop tells Eric explicitly hates: drawer cards, misshapen box mosaics, glass effects, decorative gradients, emoji feature grids, uniform rounded-card dashboards
New arbitrary hex values when a token exists
Equal-weight card grids where everything shouts

decisions: 2026-08-23: Coach agent sheet is a prep sheet — weekly brief on top with inline evidence, 1:1 workzone next, reference folded (Eric approved, PR #47).
2026-08-23: Personality material gets its own designed Profile view entered from the agent sheet — valuable, but never in the weekly workflow's face (Eric).

2026-09-03: The interior moves to 'spatial glass', benchmarked against apple.com/apple-vision-pro (checked, not remembered): a LIGHT neutral room — off-white ground (#F5F5F7), white plates, near-black text (#1D1D1F), grey secondary (#6E6E73/#86868B), one blue (#0071E3) for the single thing that wants a click, warmth only on status. White frosted glass ONLY on floating chrome (capsule sidebar, island, command bar, sign-in door); tables and text stay solid. Dark is reserved for the one cinematic moment (sign-in keeps the brand scene behind white glass). Two earlier dark/violet cuts were tints invented from the brief's numbers and were rejected. Palette lives in web/src/truHqSpatial.css, loaded last. The marketing site keeps amber-forest on purpose.

2026-09-03: Pulse module pass. Watch rows are white plates (ember edge only when someone needs a conversation). Leads-per-contract scale is a grey rail and a black line; dots are near-black unless past the line (ember). Sea/gold stripped off avatars, tags, bars, the person pane, and primary pills. Small labels go to sentence case — tracking-out caps were a dark-room voice and read as generic SaaS on white. ScaleMarks tones: bad=ember, warn/ok=grey/black (accent is now the click colour, not a warning).

2026-09-03: The room is Apple grey 5 (#E8E8ED), not paper. White is a window (frosted glass) sitting on that grey — same family as Vision Pro / iOS grouped tables. Solid white plates on a white ground was the flood. Pulse: only the scale, the people who need you, and the roster are windows; the five satellite numbers sit on the room.

2026-09-03: Everyday screens move to the dark half of the Vision Pro page (the technology section). The light bands on that page only rest the eye because they sit next to dark photographs — a dashboard of numbers has none, so the same grey is a lamp. Room is black, type is #F5F5F7, windows are #1C1C1E so a panel is never the wall. One blue #0A84FF. Not forest, not violet.
2026-09-03: Floor lifted off pure black. Room is charcoal (#1C1C1E), windows a step lighter (#2C2C2E) so it reads as a dim room, not a cave. Same type, blue, and status warmth.
